clue.text: Cover roof of building pointed out by vicar?

parts.note: that is the word used when indicating something by pointing
CH is the abbreviation for church, the building a vicar would point to; the question mark flags the indirect hint

explanation.surface: A vicar points at a building and suggests covering its roof.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the wordplay as the vicar saying 'that church', with CH the standard abbreviation for church.
explanation.definitionFit: To thatch is to roof a building with straw or reeds, so it covers that roof.

clue.text: Great expense in 20 12, something dangerous about to go off

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the explosive goes round the other piece

parts.note: TNT, the high explosive, is something dangerous
to ride is to go off on horseback or a bike

explanation.surface: A costly item in a weapons programme is like a bomb about to explode.
explanation.walkthrough: '20 12' points to the linked entry NUCLEAR SUBMARINE: the Trident missile system is the great expense of Britain's nuclear submarine fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: Trident is Britain's submarine-launched missile system, famously costly to maintain and renew.

clue.text: All for Deutschland, the one lunatic?

definitions.text: All for Deutschland, the one lunatic?

indicators.note: lunatic means crazy, so these letters go mad and are rearranged

parts.note: D is the international vehicle code for Germany, Deutschland
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A mad German leader wanted everything for his country.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the dictator who wanted all for Germany, and was arguably a lunatic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nazi dictator demanded everything for Germany and is often portrayed as a madman.

clue.text: Drink being sorted, perhaps, something for the knight

parts.note: cha is slang for tea, a drink
letters being sorted at a post office are in the mail

explanation.surface: Tea is being sorted, and something is set aside for the knight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being sorted' suggests an anagram, but there is none: post that is being sorted is IN MAIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Armour made of interlinked metal rings was worn by medieval knights.

clue.text: Great expense in 20 12, say, image seen behind my back in Russian debacle, briefly

indicators.note: in places the image and reversed word inside the Russian debacle

parts.note: Olga is a typical Russian woman's name

indicators.note: behind means the picture comes after the reversed word
back means the word my is read backwards

parts.note: a pic is an image or photograph

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a debacle is a mess

explanation.surface: Picture a costly event: an image behind my back during a Russian fiasco.
explanation.walkthrough: The Olympic Games of 2012 were held in London at huge cost. OLGA and MES (MESS shortened by 'briefly') surround YM ('my back') followed by PIC.
explanation.definitionFit: The 2012 Olympic Games in London were an example of enormous public expense.

clue.text: Refuse collector in battle of the big boys brought up major 23

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the whole is read from bottom to top
in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: sumo is wrestling between huge men
a bin collects refuse

explanation.surface: A rubbish bin turns up in a heavyweight bout as a major story.
explanation.walkthrough: 23 is ISSUE, so 'major 23' is a major issue: an omnibus edition. 'In' places one piece inside another, and 'brought up' turns the whole result upside down.
explanation.definitionFit: An omnibus edition is a large issue gathering several parts into one publication.

clue.text: Unknown people in clearing once found plant

parts.note: Y is an algebraic unknown
UCCA, the Universities Central Council on Admissions, ran British university clearing before UCAS replaced it

explanation.surface: Unidentified people clearing ground long ago discovered a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: Clearing is the British system that places students in unfilled university places; UCCA ran it until 1993.
explanation.definitionFit: The yucca is a spiky-leaved plant of the agave family.

clue.text: Filthy sport heading for receivership, one beset by money which is filthy

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so money goes around the other pieces

parts.note: pence are money
RU is rugby union, a muddy and filthy sport

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A grubby sport heads for bankruptcy, surrounded by dirty money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Filthy sport' is rugby, played in mud; the definition 'which is filthy' stands for a filthy-minded quality. 'Beset by' wraps the money round the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Prurience is an unhealthy interest in sexual matters, a filthy-minded quality.

clue.text: Sailing vessel, clipper

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a small sailing boat and a tool or person that cuts.

clue.text: Having to skip many, skip the Old Testament as religious book

indicators.note: skip here means leave out, so those letters are omitted

parts.note: having to skip many is having to miss a lot
OT is the abbreviation for the Old Testament

explanation.surface: Someone skipping much of scripture leaves out the Old Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: A missal is the book of prayers used at Catholic Mass.

clue.text: One's speech given change of direction to show detachment

parts.note: I is one; with 's it gives IS

indicators.note: right becomes left, so the R abbreviation is swapped for L

parts.note: an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: Someone's speech changes course to reveal aloofness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change of direction' swaps R (right) for L (left) in ORATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolation is a state of separation, which is a sense of detachment.

clue.text: Noble matter

definitions.meaning: a European nobleman equal to an earl
to be important, as in 'every vote matters'

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a nobleman and also means to be of importance.

clue.text: In Spain, the goal appears delicate

parts.note: el is the Spanish for the
fin, as in French, is an end or goal

explanation.surface: In Spanish football, the goal looks fragile.
explanation.definitionFit: Elfin describes something small and dainty, like an elf.

clue.text: See 20
Body part — one developed in extremity

indicators.note: in puts the shuffled letters inside the extremity

parts.note: a tail is an extremity

indicators.note: developed means grown into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A body part has grown at the very end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Developed' rearranges the word one, and 'in' puts the result inside the extremity.
explanation.definitionFit: The nail on a toe is a part of the human body.

clue.text: I'm red and pale, awfully skinny?

indicators.note: awfully means badly, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone flushed then pale looks dreadfully thin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skinny' is meant as 'to do with skin', hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Epidermal means relating to the outer layer of skin, a punning sense of skinny.

clue.text: I'm among Japanese people recording crime

indicators.note: among places this piece inside the company name

parts.note: Sony is a Japanese electronics and recording company

explanation.surface: I'm part of a Japanese recording firm doing something criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: Simony is the sin or offence of buying and selling church offices.

clue.text: Isle that could be an alcoholic drink

definitions.meaning: the island at the heart of New York City
a cocktail of whiskey and vermouth

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the New York island and a whiskey cocktail.

clue.text: See 2
Plan to wear musical outfit

indicators.note: a musical wearing the plan has it on the outside

parts.note: Rent is a Broadway musical
to aim is to plan

explanation.surface: A scheme to dress in a musical costume.
explanation.definitionFit: Raiment is an old word for clothing, an outfit.

clue.text: Prison the end product, given a lot of time

parts.note: dung is what comes out at the end, a waste product
an eon is a very long time

explanation.surface: Prison life: waste product plus a lengthy sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A dungeon is an underground cell where prisoners were kept.

clue.text: Not so light and not so bright

definitions.meaning: a device that turns lights down

explanation.definitionFit: A light switch that lowers the light shares a word with the comparative of dim.

clue.text: Vessel enables uranium to be transported with care, oddly

indicators.note: transported means carried away, so these letters are moved around
the odd-numbered letters are taken

explanation.surface: A ship that carries uranium must be moved with odd caution.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange ENABLES, URANIUM and CR (the odd letters of 'care').
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear submarine is a vessel powered by a reactor.

clue.text: Dish bagged, as witches having bottom pinched

indicators.note: the bottom of a down word is its last letter, which is stolen

parts.note: haggish means like a hag or witch

explanation.surface: A dish in a bag, like witches whose bottoms have been pinched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bagged' belongs to the definition: haggis is cooked in a sheep's stomach. It is a Scottish pudding of offal and oatmeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Haggis is a Scottish dish traditionally cooked in a stomach bag.

clue.text: A parent snatches boy beginning to ingest metal

indicators.note: snatches means grabs and holds, so mum goes around the boy

parts.note: mum is a parent
Eric is a boy's name

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A mother grabs her son just as he starts eating metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Americium is a radioactive metallic element, number 95.

clue.text: Kids' publication

explanation.definitionFit: The word means offspring and also one edition of a periodical.

clue.text: This clings to meat while good and cold

parts.note: as can mean while
pi is short for pious, good
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Something that sticks to meat when it is good and cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Aspic is a savoury jelly set around cold meats.

clue.text: Call couldn't be more acidic?

definitions.meaning: read as ..., the very acidic end of the scale

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits as PH ONE: a pH of 1 is strongly acidic.
explanation.definitionFit: To phone is to make a call; split, it also gives a very acid pH reading.

clue.text: See 4
Conductor having to decide upon baton, last to choose

parts.note: to elect is to choose or decide upon
a baton is a rod

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: An orchestra conductor having to choose a baton at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conductor' looks like a music director with a baton; it is an electrical conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: An electrode is a conductor through which current enters or leaves.

clue.text: Debt free, which is not to be sniffed at!

definitions.text: which is not to be sniffed at!
definitions.meaning: a liquid such as glue thinner, abused by sniffing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means owing nothing, and also a dissolving liquid inhaled in substance abuse.

clue.text: Attract attention following climax

indicators.note: following places attention after the climax

parts.note: the end is the climax
an ear is attention, as in 'lend an ear'

explanation.surface: Attention comes after the climax of a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear is to win affection, to draw someone to you.
